title: 3 + 4 = 5? Scalars and Vectors Explained Simply | PUC Physics Class 11
description:
Ten kilograms of rice plus ten kilograms is always twenty. But a push of ten newtons plus another push of ten newtons can be twenty, zero or anything in between. And Aarav rides 3 km east and 4 km north, his trip meter says 7 km, yet he is only 5 km from the college gate. In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Physics (NCERT Chapter 3, Motion in a Plane) we learn the difference between scalars and vectors.

You watch Aarav's ride on a live motion notebook: the distance counter climbs while the displacement arrow swings and grows, with a slow-motion replay of the turn and a live graph of distance and displacement. We work out why 3 + 4 = 5 for vectors with the triangle law and Pythagoras, see why speed is a scalar but velocity is a vector, learn when two vectors are equal, and test it all with two pause-and-think questions. Then a worked example, the exam trap about a there-and-back trip, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11, JEE Main and NEET students.

In this video:

0:32 What are scalars and vectors?

2:22 Side by side + pause and think
3:00 Is it a scalar or a vector? Follow the links
3:27 Equal vectors + pause and think
4:00 Worked example: 8 m east, 6 m north
4:32 Exam trap: there and back
4:55 Practice question (JEE Main pattern)
